summary: On paper Dallas has the edge (Dallas' defense ranks 10th in broken tackles per touch, 10.7% missed), while the Giants's best counter is to tackle in space (The Giants' defense ranks 10th in YAC over expected per catch, -0.3 yds allowed). Under center, Dak Prescott ranks 7th of 31 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: CeeDee Lamb gets 35% of Dallas' targets and 43% of its air yards, and His WOPR (0.79) ranks 4th of 1211. The Giants' pass defense ranks 10th. The model favors Dallas at 73%, mostly on rushing matchup (2.6 pts) and starting QB (2.3 pts).
